messages:
Alice: quick q — hitting intermittent 429s on /v1/generate when we burst after idle. No Retry-After header returned, only 429 with body {"error":"quota_exceeded"}. Anyone seen this?
Ben: saw a similar spike in staging yesterday, quota-bot showed 'bucket=route:generate state=exhausted'. SDK fallback didn't catch it.
Carlos: is the SDK looking for Retry-After or X-RateLimit-Reset? We discussed deprecating X-RateLimit-* for per-route quotas last quarter.
Dana: SDK currently prefers Retry-After, then X-RateLimit-Reset as fallback. If neither present we treat as hard fail (no backoff) — that's probably the bug.
Evelyn: on the runtime side we return 429 when the burst pool empties. We avoided adding bucket identifiers in headers for privacy/anti-enumeration, which is why headers were sparse. We can add standard Retry-After (seconds) + X-RateLimit-Remaining=0 and X-RateLimit-Reset (epoch) without leaking bucket ids.
Ben: that sounds good. Can we standardize to include Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset (epoch secs)? SDKs should prefer Retry-After.
Alice: any objections to keeping bucket id out of headers? we need it for debugging but prefer it in logs/obs not the public contract.
Carlos: +1 for no bucket in headers. Prefer trace-id in headers so support can look up the bucket in the UI.
Dana: also recommend a small structured 429 body: {"code":"quota_exhausted", "retry_after": 3} so SDKs can parse reliably.
Evelyn: runtime can emit that body and the Retry-After header. Will need a PR for the different runners.
Alice: docs/console update needed too — @Ben can you take that?
Ben: I got this. I'll draft an "API contract: 429 / quota" note with guidance for SDKs and examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3245
quota-bot: detected 12 events of 429 on /v1/generate between 1832500200–1832501000, top caller=svc-analytics
deploy-bot: canary deployed a runtime change to add Retry-After in canary region; logs show header present on test hits.
Carlos: nice. Dana — can you add SDK unit tests for backoff parsing and a fallback if headers/body missing? will ping for review.
Dana: yep will add tests and a feature flag. target EOD. @Evelyn, do you want a schema snippet for the 429 body in the PR?
Evelyn: please — I'll include this schema in the runtime PR: ```json
{
  "code": "quota_exhausted",
  "message": "route quota exceeded",
  "retry_after": 3
}
```
Alice: solid. Action items: Evelyn PR for runtime changes, Dana SDK tests + review, Ben docs + console note. We'll monitor canary for 24h then roll to prod if clean. :thumbsup:
